name: What is the difference between a custom home and a semi-custom or production home?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a custom home and a semi-custom or production home?

acceptedAnswer.text: A custom home is uniquely designed from the ground up to meet the specific desires, lifestyle, and site conditions of a single client, offering unparalleled personalization in layout, features, and finishes. Semi-custom homes are built from existing floor plans that can be modified to some extent, with choices from a limited selection of finishes. Production homes, conversely, are built on speculation using standardized plans and materials, offering minimal to no customization. Opus Builders specializes exclusively in fully custom homes.
acceptedAnswer.description: A custom home is a unique, client-specific design, unlike semi-custom homes with limited modifications or production homes with no customization. Opus Builders specializes in fully custom homes.
